name: Agent Browser
description: Browser automation via the `agent-browser` CLI's MCP server (https://agent-browser.dev). Provides the swappable `browser.control` layer, so selecting it re-points the stable `browser__*` tools at agent-browser without changing what agents call. Launched via `npx agent-browser mcp`; needs Node on PATH.
tagline: A second real browser for the browser.control layer

agentbrowser.description: Agent Browser — browser automation over MCP (navigate, snapshot, click, type, scroll, screenshot, tabs). Launched via `npx -y agent-browser mcp`; unavailable until Node is installed and the package can be fetched.
